parties.counterparty: SFG Financial Corp, a/k/a E-Path FX (Licensor)

plans.note: Liability limits in this form usually sit with the all-caps disclaimer block (Article VIX / WARRANTY DISCLAIMER, sec-p0109 through sec-p0116) or in General Provisions. Check whether any cap is one-sided in Licensor's favour, whether consequential damages are excluded mutually, and whether carve-outs (IP infringement, confidentiality breach, gross negligence/willful misconduct) exist.

No indemnity heading appears in the outline; with a broad warranty disclaimer and no IP indemnity article, a Licensor IP/misconduct indemnity is likely missing. Confirm by scanning General Provisions (sec-xxiv/sec-p0144) and the licence restrictions in Article II before proposing insertion.

Check the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION article (sec-x, sec-p0123) for any covenant restricting our competing activities, and Article II 'LICENSE GRANT AND RESTRICTIONS' plus the FIELD OF USE definition, which can operate as a de facto non-compete on our business lines.

The defined term 'Right of First Refusal' signals a possible exclusivity/first-call obligation on us; trace its operative clause (likely Article VIII or the commercial terms) and any FIELD OF USE limitation restricting sourcing from other providers.

No pricing-parity language is evident; the tiered per-unit rates (sec-p0059 to sec-p0063) and 'Supplemental Payments' should be checked for any obligation running against us to give Licensor best terms. MFN in our favour would be a nice-to-have, not a demand.

Squarely in the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION article. Verify mutuality, duration (target 12 months post-termination), scope limited to employees with whom the other party had contact, and a carve-out for general advertising and unsolicited applicants.

Term and termination provisions likely sit in Article VIII (which appears to carry the commercial/fee terms and the 'Initial Period') or in General Provisions. Confirm we have convenience termination on notice without penalty and that Licensor cannot terminate at will mid-term; watch for acceleration of Supplemental Payments on exit.

Follow the 'Initial Period' definition (sec-i) to its operative renewal clause. Check for automatic renewal, the length of the non-renewal notice window (we want no more than 30 days), and whether renewal pricing is capped rather than at Licensor's discretion.

Expect governing law, venue and any dispute-resolution/arbitration clause in Article XXIV GENERAL PROVISIONS. Given the New York address blocks (sec-575, sec-575-2), New York law and New York courts are likely acceptable; flag any foreign arbitration or offshore forum.

Assignment and change-of-control language should be in General Provisions. Confirm we may assign to Affiliates (see AFFILIATE definition) and to a successor by merger or asset sale without consent, and that our change of control is not a Licensor termination trigger.

Direction check across the definitions (DERIVATIVE WORK, INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS, MORAL RIGHTS, LICENSED TECHNOLOGY) and Article II: ensure no assignment or licence-back to Licensor of our data, feedback, configurations or customer/trading data, and that anything we pay to have developed is ours or at minimum licensed to us broadly.

Core grant is Article II with scope driven by FIELD OF USE, PLATFORM SOFTWARE and LICENSED SOFTWARE definitions. Push for Affiliate and contractor use rights and remove any 'revocable at will' or unilateral suspension language; also review the acknowledgement subparagraphs for hidden use restrictions.

Usage-audit or reporting/verification rights are commonly tucked into the licence restrictions (Article II) or the fee-reporting mechanics tied to Market Day volumes. If present, hold to annual frequency, 10+ business days' notice, business hours, and Licensor's cost absent material underpayment.

No penalty heading appears; check the fee tiers and 'Supplemental Payments' mechanics for shortfall charges, late-fee interest or accelerated payments that function as liquidated damages against us, plus any stipulated-damages language in General Provisions.

Article VIX is a full WARRANTY DISCLAIMER (merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, and no assurance that defects in the software or Documentation will be corrected). We need an affirmative performance/conformity-to-Documentation warranty with a repair-replace-refund remedy, and the disclaimer narrowed accordingly.

No insurance article is visible in the outline. Since Licensor hosts the Platform and touches our trading data, propose standard coverages (commercial general liability, professional liability/E&O, cyber) in General Provisions if confirmed absent.

The volume-tiered rate table (sec-p0059 to sec-p0063) plus 'Supplemental Payments' and 'Market Day' definitions suggest a minimum-volume or minimum-fee construct. Identify any take-or-pay floor and pair it with a convenience-termination or true-up exit.

No wind-down or data-return provision is apparent; check the termination clause and the confidentiality article's return/destruction language. If absent, seek a defined transition period, export of our data in usable format, and continued access at then-current rates.
